description: G2 v2+ cloud GPU load (amendment A2a rule 6). The C1 competitor is the edge-load worker on the cloud GPU. Candidates are swept in phase E3 (20 cloud/raw_image requests each, unshaped, edge idle); C1 is the smallest candidate whose median cloud server time is 1.4-1.6x the C0 median, copied into levels and committed before the pilot. Until then the grid's C1 cells cannot run.
